ana: heads-up customer report: stream abort during toolcall -> retry -> double billing. repro attached.

mike: can you paste the minimal log? which tool?

ana: simple: model redwood/llama-x, tool=vector_search. sequence: start stream req=one99 -> client 499 at chunk 6 -> client retries new req=two88 -> both tool finishes billed.

jorge: ledger keys use request_id so retry writes new row. quick mitigation: 8s dedupe window keyed by customer+tool+prompt_hash to mark near-duplicate finishes as duplicates. low-risk.

lina: long-term: provisional ledger rows. when tool finishes but stream not acked, write provisional (non-billable). confirm on ack or timeout. console needs toggle to show provisional. billing webhooks for provisional->confirmed.

mike: router tweak: if incoming connection supplies X-Redwood-Session or Idempotency-Key reuse as provision_handle. otherwise compute sha256(customer+tool+prompt_hash+prefix_kv).

ana: logs: [2026-01-05T12:00:01Z] req=one99 stream chunk=5 tool.start vector_search
[2026-01-05T12:00:02Z] req=one99 client disconnected (499)
[2026-01-05T12:00:03Z] req=two88 non-stream fallback tool.start vector_search
[2026-01-05T12:00:04Z] req=one99 tool.finish tokens=176
[2026-01-05T12:00:05Z] req=two88 tool.finish tokens=170

jorge: telemetry counters: toolcall.prov.created, .confirmed, .expired, .duplicate.detected. tag with reconcile_method.

lina: finance note: provisional must not show on invoices. confirm emits usage webhook. customers must be notified if usage moves post-confirm.

mike: rollout: 1) hotfix dedupe window (8s) + telemetry (canary) 2) provisional ledger + console toggle + webhook 3) recommend Idempotency-Key in devex docs.
